name: Handful of Oats (Classic)
summary: Handfuls of Oats are simple grains salvaged from the abandoned farmsteads of Westfall. They serve as essential feed for working livestock like Old Blanchy, who struggle under the weight of refugee travel.

sections.title: Fodder Among the Ruins
sections.body: Once the breadbasket of the Kingdom of Stormwind, Westfall's vast agrarian plots now lie overgrown or overrun by Defias bandits and rogue harvest golems. Despite the collapse of order, sacks of cultivated grain and oats remain abandoned near outbuildings, barns, and overgrown plots. For travelers and refugees stranded by broken wagons along the dusty roads, recovering handfuls of these leftover oats is one of the few ways to nourish weary draft horses.

faq.q: What are Handfuls of Oats used for?
faq.answer: They are collected to feed Old Blanchy, a weary mare belonging to the Furlbrow family. After their wagon broke down along the road in Westfall, she was left exhausted and in desperate need of nourishment.

faq.q: Where can these oats be found?
faq.answer: Handfuls of Oats are scooped from sacks scattered around the abandoned farms across Westfall, particularly to the southwest. Some can also occasionally be scavenged from prowling gnolls and mechanical harvesters in the fields.

faq.q: Why are the oat sacks left unguarded?
faq.answer: The sudden rise of the Defias Brotherhood and the rampage of rogue harvest machinery forced local farmers to flee their lands in haste, leaving harvested grains and supplies behind in their fields and barns.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers passing through Westfall, scrounging oats to help stranded refugees like the Furlbrows is a small act of mercy amidst Stormwind's neglected frontier.
